server.title: Search Fragments
server.description: Resolves half-remembered books, films, songs and people into a cited answer, a shortlist or a no.

serverInfo.name: search-fragments-mcp
serverInfo.description: Search Fragments is an MCP server with three tools for queries an agent can't place. resolve_fragment: resolves half-remembered, cross-source queries — returns a named answer with confidence justified by evidence (resolved), ranked web sources to confirm by eye (shortlist), or an explicit no-resolution. verify_claim: checks a specific factual assertion against current web sources — returns supported, partially_supported, insufficient_evidence, or unsupported, with cited evidence and stated limits. submit_resolution_feedback: reports whether a resolve_fragment result was accepted, partial or rejected, using its resolution_id. Built to decline rather than guess.
